def require_unentered_apply01(ops, control):
    key='t45-r3-ordinary34-auth-apply-20261116-01'
    root=WORKER/key
    terminal=ops.read_file(root/'r3-outer-terminal.json',65536,True)
    need(sha(terminal)=='39dd96689785ea6fc041eef092fd3097677f2e3ffbc3c5c6b56f2fce482c3600'
         and terminal==ops.read_file(control/'results'/(key+'.json'),65536,False,False),'APPLY02_ACTUAL_01_TERMINAL_REQUIRED')
    t=ops.strict(terminal)
    need((t['jobId'],t['status'],t['exitCode'],t['phaseStarted'])==(key,'REFUSED_R3_CONTINUITY_BEFORE_PHASE',2,False)
         and t['exports']==[] and t['errorCode']=='R3_CONTINUITY_DIRECT33_EXACT_FINITE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED','APPLY02_01_MUST_BE_PREPHASE_REFUSAL')
    raw=ops.read_file(root/'request.json',65536,True)
    need(sha(raw)=='39bcfdde2286969bd3fd9035ad5efcc0e42d279453b5f997c8ba2e9bd2505807' and ops.strict(raw)['args']==[],'APPLY02_01_EXACT_MISSING_ARG_REQUEST_REQUIRED')
    need(sha(ops.read_file(root/'bundle/roles-authorization.json',65536,True))=='60ff1ff38900e1d07001486e05848124b1ed64bba0ea425357d4ac9006af16c6','APPLY02_01_UNUSED_ROLE_REFERENCE_REQUIRED')
    need(not any(present(p) for p in [root/'phase.private.log',*[root/'results'/n for n in ('maintenance-auth-intent.json','maintenance-auth-inside.json','maintenance-auth-cleanup.json','maintenance-auth-result.json')],ROOT/'state/native-services/ordinary34-auth-20261116-01',ROOT/'state/fresh35-first-production-20261110-r3/ordinary34-auth-capture-20261116-01']),'APPLY02_INNER34_ALREADY_ENTERED_NO_REPLAY')
    ids=command(['docker','ps','-a','--filter','name=^/'+key+'$','--format','{{.ID}}'],5)
    need(not ids.strip(),'APPLY02_01_MAINTENANCE_CONTAINER_PRESENT')
functions.validate:
def validate(a, phase, now):
    fixed = scope(phase)
    extra = {'startsAt', 'expiresAt', 'authorizationReference', 'independentReviewSha256',
             'rolesAuthoritySha256', 'rolesSourceSha256', 'hostSourceSha256'}
    if phase == 'restore':
        extra |= {'service', 'writerTerminalSha256', 'policySha256', 'stopRequestKey',
                  'stopTerminalSha256', 'stopResultSha256', 'stopCleanupSha256'}
    need(type(a) is dict and set(a) == set(fixed) | extra
         and all(a[k] == v for k, v in fixed.items()), 'MAINT_JOB_EXACT_EXTERNAL_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
    need(type(now) is int and type(a['startsAt']) is type(a['expiresAt']) is int
         and a['startsAt'] <= now and now + 300000 < a['expiresAt'] <= a['startsAt'] + 1800000,
         'MAINT_JOB_EXTERNAL_WINDOW_REQUIRED')
    need(type(a['authorizationReference']) is str and 0 < len(a['authorizationReference']) <= 512
         and all(type(a[k]) is str and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}', a[k]) for k in
                 ('independentReviewSha256', 'rolesAuthoritySha256', 'rolesSourceSha256', 'hostSourceSha256')),
         'MAINT_JOB_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED')

def validate(authority, now, restoring=False):
    fixed = scope()
    extra = {'startsAt', 'expiresAt', 'controllerValidUntil', 'backupAdminValidUntil', 'restorationDeadline',
             'authorizationReference', 'rolesSourceSha256', 'independentReviewSha256'}
    need(type(authority) is dict and set(authority) == set(fixed) | extra
         and all(authority[k] == v for k, v in fixed.items()), 'MAINT_EXACT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED')
    a = authority
    need(all(type(a[k]) is int for k in ('startsAt', 'expiresAt', 'controllerValidUntil', 'backupAdminValidUntil', 'restorationDeadline'))
         and a['startsAt'] < a['expiresAt'] <= a['startsAt'] + 1800000
         and a['expiresAt'] < a['controllerValidUntil'] <= a['backupAdminValidUntil'] < a['restorationDeadline']
         <= a['startsAt'] + 12600000, 'MAINT_FINITE_AUTH_AND_RESTORATION_WINDOW_REQUIRED')
    deadline = a['restorationDeadline'] if restoring else a['expiresAt']
    need(type(now) is int and a['startsAt'] <= now and now + 30000 < deadline,
         'MAINT_ORIGINAL_WINDOW_EXPIRED')
    need(type(a['authorizationReference']) is str and 0 < len(a['authorizationReference']) <= 512
         and all(type(a[k]) is str and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}', a[k])
                 for k in ('rolesSourceSha256', 'independentReviewSha256')), 'MAINT_EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED')

def validate_authority(a,now):
    fixed=scope();dynamic={'previousTerminalSha256','previousResultSha256','previousCleanupSha256','previousCurrentProofSha256',
                           'previousIncompleteRootSha256','previousRetainedAckSha256','restoreTerminalSha256','restoreResultSha256',
                           'applyTerminalSha256','applyResultSha256'}
    del fixed['maximumServiceSeconds']
    extra={'startsAt','expiresAt','serviceLeaseExpiresAt','capacityExpiresAt','maximumServiceSeconds','authorizationReference','normalServiceSha256','proofSourceSha256','record38Sha256','phaseResults','phaseTerminals'}|dynamic
    need(type(a) is dict and set(a)==set(fixed)|extra and all(a[k]==v for k,v in fixed.items()),'NORMAL_EXACT_AUTHORITY_SCOPE_REQUIRED')
    need(type(now) is int and all(type(a[k]) is int for k in ('startsAt','expiresAt','serviceLeaseExpiresAt','capacityExpiresAt','maximumServiceSeconds'))
         and a['startsAt']<=now<a['expiresAt']<=a['startsAt']+1800000
         and a['maximumServiceSeconds']>0
         and a['serviceLeaseExpiresAt']==a['capacityExpiresAt']==a['startsAt']+a['maximumServiceSeconds']*1000
         and a['serviceLeaseExpiresAt'] < 2**53
         and a['expiresAt']<work_deadline(a), 'NORMAL_COORDINATION_AND_SERVICE_WINDOWS_REQUIRED')
    need(type(a['authorizationReference']) is str and 0<len(a['authorizationReference'])<=512
         and all(is_digest(a[k]) for k in ({'normalServiceSha256','proofSourceSha256','record38Sha256'}|dynamic))
         and all(type(a[k]) is dict and set(a[k])==set(PHASES)
                 and all(is_digest(value) for value in a[k].values()) for k in ('phaseResults','phaseTerminals'))
         and a['phaseResults']['SQL36']==SQL36_ROOT_RESULT and a['phaseTerminals']['SQL36']==SQL36_TERMINAL,
         'NORMAL_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_REVIEW_REFERENCE_REQUIRED')
    need(micros(a['admin154PostmasterStart'])<micros(SERVICE14_EPOCH)<micros(a['ddlPostmasterStart'])<micros(PREVIOUS_EPOCH)<a['startsAt']*1000,
         'NORMAL05_ACTUAL_SERVICE15_DDL_EPOCH_REQUIRED')
    return work_deadline(a)
